I'd like to go through the required items now. Mr. Greene, could you please provide me with the exact list of trained host students who will be eligible to host the broadcast? Ms. Novak, I'll need the exact approved platform settings for the stream. And Mr. Ellis, please share the exact privacy restrictions and required records we'll need to maintain. Once I have all three of those, I'll record the factual bases and we can finalize the plan.
